MAR.note: The document describes no authentication, e-signature or digital ID service.

facts.fact: Hespress reports that DGSN opened its Epolice portal to Moroccans abroad from 9 November 2026 to apply online for criminal record certificates, with tracking online and collection at a chosen diplomatic mission.

MAR.note: The document gives no count or share of the population holding a national ID.
